instruction: A cinematic film still captured in a medium shot inside a brightly lit boxing gym. Two fighters stand opposite each other inside the boxing ring, preparing for a match. On the left side of the frame, the shirtless, sweaty dark-skinned man with a beard (R2) stands in profile facing right. On the right side, the shirtless light-skinned man with braided hair and a tribal shoulder tattoo (R1) stands in profile facing left. The two men maintain intense, unwavering eye contact with serious expressions. The background shows the boxing ring ropes, hanging heavy bags, and a polished wooden floor under bright, even indoor gym lighting.
